column3: “Temple” is rendered “nave”; NASB omits the final “the breadth of the tent.”
“Three and thirty times” is rendered “three stories … thirty in each story”; the Hebrew is difficult.
The Hebrew of this verse is very difficult; the meaning is uncertain.
“Separate place” is rendered “separate area,” and “sea” as “west.”
“Measurements” is rendered “by measurement”; the meaning is uncertain.
The Hebrew is terse and difficult; the meaning is uncertain.
“Its length” is rendered “its base,” following the LXX.
